data.name: Meha
data.gender_notes: Meha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahana' which means 'delight' or 'pleasure'. This name holds a significant spiritual meaning in Islam, as it is also the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his generosity and kindness. The name Meha carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Meha usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes joy and contentment in one's faith and spiritual journey in Islam.
data.etymology: Meha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
